title: Access control and checking in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: UE state where NAS connection is active, including variant with RRC inactive indication.

entities.name: Access control procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE categorizes access attempts into access identities and categories, provides them to lower layers for access control checking.

entities.name: Uplink data status IE
entities.description: Information element indicating PDU sessions with pending uplink user data, included in REGISTRATION REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST messages.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for registration procedure, can include Uplink data status IE.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for service request procedure, can include Uplink data status IE.

entities.name: NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to transport SMS, PDU session messages, location requests, and UE policy transactions via UL NAS TRANSPORT messages.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to re-establish user-plane resources for existing PDU sessions.

entities.name: Access attempt allowed
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate that the access attempt is permitted.

entities.name: Access attempt barred
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message used to carry SMS, PDU session requests, location requests, and UE policy transactions.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent to establish a new PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent to modify an existing PDU session.

relations.description: Access control procedure is performed when UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains Uplink data status IE when uplink user data is pending.
SERVICE REQUEST message contains Uplink data status IE when uplink user data is pending.
When access is allowed, NAS transport procedure is initiated for SMS, PDU session establishment/modification, location requests, and UE policy transactions.
When access is allowed, service request procedure is initiated to re-establish user-plane resources.
NAS transport procedure involves sending UL NAS TRANSPORT message.
When access is barred, NAS transport procedure is not initiated.
When access is barred, service request procedure is not initiated.
NAS transport procedure is used to send PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.
NAS transport procedure is used to send PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
